annotations.title: Record a shoe the person already owns

description: Records a shoe the person owns and the size they wear in it. This is what every recommendation is built from, so ask for at least one shoe that fits them well before calling recommend_size. Use find_shoe first to get the identifiers.

answers.description: The complete set of answers from find_shoe, including the size they wear. find_shoe says when it is complete.

sessionId.description: The session id returned by start_session. Everything the person tells you is stored against it, and it is the only thing linking one call to the next.

name: add_shoe
title: Record a shoe the person already owns
